title: Unix and Google
summary: A short animated simulation comparing how Multics and Unix were developed, showing why Unix's small composable programs and pipes gave it a efficiency advantage. It frames Unix as a moonshot achievable by a small team.
why: Cited constantly in threads on microservices, composability and the Unix philosophy as a compact explanation of why small interoperable pieces win.

quote.text: A guy on YT [1] simulates in 7 minutes how the two biggest operating systems were built in the sixties
